name: modelo-base-pilates

description.physical: woman in her early-to-mid 30s, olive-tan skin tone with natural freckles across shoulders and arms, long dark brown wavy hair worn loose, sharp jawline, brown eyes, athletic toned build with visible lean muscle definition
description.grooming: no visible makeup, natural brows, minimal styling, windswept hair
description.wardrobe_default: black activewear set (cropped tank over sports bra, high-waisted leggings), matte fabric, no logos
description.pose_mood: confident, calm, slight over-the-shoulder or side profile stance, arms crossed, direct or off-camera gaze
description.background_default: seamless light grey studio backdrop, soft even lighting, no shadows on backdrop

prompt_fragment: same recurring female model: early-to-mid 30s, olive-tan skin with natural freckles, long dark brown wavy hair, athletic toned build, brown eyes, sharp jawline, no makeup, consistent facial identity across all shots
notes: Usar siempre esta fracción de prompt para mantener consistencia de identidad entre generaciones. La imagen de referencia (reference_image) es para uso interno del equipo como guía visual; el modelo de generación actual (APIMART) no soporta image-to-image, por lo que la consistencia depende del prompt_fragment.
